title: Easy to Use
text: Easy to Use. These ice ball molds are so much easier to use than the silicone ones that came out a few years ago. It was so tricky to fill those older ones without getting water everywhere! I love the design of these molds! My husband likes adding a large single ice ball to his bourbon. These make very nice ice balls!

product_metadata.title: Ice Ball Maker Mold, 4 Pack Silicone Sphere Whiskey Ice Ball Maker with Lids, Novelty Round Large Ice Cube Molds for Cocktails Bourbon, Reusable Bulb Ice Hockey Mold, Unique Gift for Men Women
features: Large-sized Round Ice Balls: With our ice ball mold maker, you can create perfectly round 2.36-inch sized balls. Use 1 ice ball to refresh 2-3 drinks without losing the real flavor!

BPA-Free Silicone Design: Our Ice Ball Maker Mold set of 4 are made of food grade silicone and AS plastic, safe and hygienic. They can withstand long-term low-temperature storage without breaking. Easy to clean and reusable.

Easy to Use & Release: Size: 3.2*2.6inch. The silicone and AS material are closes well, just fill the round ice cube mold with water and freeze it for 6-7 hours to create Crystal Ice! Easily release the ice ball by squeezing the silicone bottom.

Get The Party Started: The perfect extra large 2.36" whiskey ice balls. They can be served with other beverages too -- vodka, ice tea, coffee, cocktails, soda, scotch, rum, tequila, juice to enhance your drinks and elevate the party!

DIY Creative Homemade Ice: This mold essentially takes the place of conventional ice cube trays. Come and make any hockey pucks you like with separate mold - fruit pucks, coffee pucks, chocolate pucks, pudding pucks, yogurt pucks.
